summary:
Welcome to Goa! You are all set for a 5-day escape to the beaches, with a total trip cost of ₹48,476.00, comfortably within your ₹50,000.00 budget. The weather is shaping up to be a classic Goan experience: currently 25.0°C (feels like 30.6°C) and overcast, with expected highs of 29.7°C and lows of 24.2°C over the next few days. With 99% humidity, you’ll want to stay hydrated and embrace the tropical vibe as you explore.

Enjoy your time in Goa! Whether you’re lounging on the sands or diving into the local culture, this trip is poised to be a memorable one. Safe travels and have a wonderful time!
